rationale: The evidence already shows that screening works, so the clinic can introduce it now while a review confirms the details.
alternatives: Local audit of current screening practice
whyNotMoreComplex: No further evaluation is needed before introducing screening.

decision.statement: Introduce routine caregiver burden screening for every caregiver at the first visit now, because screening reduces care home admission by a third (c7) and halves caregiver depression (c8).
decision.question: Should the clinic introduce routine caregiver burden screening?

criteria.text: Screening reduces care home admission by a third.

gates.evidence: Library request LIB-2026-118 confirming up to 15 hours in November 2026, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Clinician time for screening at every first visit

decision.note: Rests on claims c7 and c8.
